reachable_legends: Two: Urshifu-Single (Kubfu, gate 42) and Zapdos (gate 30). No Mythical, no Ultra Beast, no restricted legendary. Darkrai, Yveltal and Giratina are all in the cap-76 pool at gate 68 and would be the obvious way to flatten a Psychic gym; I am deliberately not using them, because a six-room gym is supposed to be the campaign's difficulty benchmark and beating it with Mt Pyre's legendaries would tell the design nothing.
plan: Built once for all six Mossdeep rooms rather than per room, because the gym's shared problem is one type. Three Dark bodies (Incineroar, Urshifu, Hydreigon) are immune to Psychic STAB outright, which is most of what this building throws. Gengar is the Ghost: it ignores Shadow Tag, which is the stated answer to rooms five and six, and Mega Gengar's own Shadow Tag turns the trap around. Weavile is the fast Knock Off - Eviolite, Light Clay, Assault Vest, Focus Sash and Sitrus are load-bearing in four of the six rooms - plus Ice Shard priority. Zapdos supplies spread damage, which is the stated answer to Ally Switch, and Electric for the Water-Psychic bodies in rooms three and six. Incineroar carries Taunt rather than Parting Shot: Trick Room, Perish Song, the screens and Calm Mind are all one Taunt away from not happening. Known hazards to respect: Xatu and Espeon bounce status, so Taunt must not be aimed at them; Cofagrigus has Mummy, so contact moves cost an ability; Farigiraf's Armor Tail switches off Sucker Punch and Ice Shard while it is on the field.
